purpose: Targeted A/B for Order 122 hypothesis 1: expose first-class generic mailbox query and attachment-save tools backed by deterministic Thunderbird MIME extraction and verified local output.
change_scope: Add generic Thunderbird attachments.save selected only by message_id/mailbox_index and attachment_name/attachment_index returned from mailbox inspection; atomically write the model-selected output_path and verify size plus SHA-256. Add thin Multi-Apps mail.query_messages and mail.save_attachment facades, first-class strict schemas, retrieval terms, and compact truthful read-back. No task identity, evaluator state, answer value, month, source filename, target filename, workbook row, or Runner-injected argument is embedded.

protocol.runner_guard_terminal_semantics: Internal guard termination records the reason and invokes the original evaluator without appending OSWorld FAIL; explicit model fail_task remains OSWorld FAIL.
protocol.on_failure: Preserve and strictly audit this single targeted A/B. Never rerun it unchanged. Attempt another Order 122 run only after a materially different reusable generic hypothesis with focused and counterfactual evidence; stop early and mark task_blocked when evidence isolates a model-side failure or the bounded hypothesis budget is exhausted. A proven transient Runner or environment fault may be retried at most twice.

implementation_evidence.counterfactual_tests: Two structurally different synthetic mailboxes use unrelated folders, senders, subjects, message selectors, attachment counts, attachment names, payloads, and output paths; contract tests cover missing selectors, relative paths, duplicates, ambiguity, existing output, and unchanged forwarding.
implementation_evidence.static_verification: Full Ruff, compileall, project layout/leakage, frozen-v1 SHA256SUMS, frozen OSWorld commit, and evaluator-tree checks passed.
implementation_evidence.real_guest_validation: A clean Docker+KVM guest deployed all current Adapters with zero Multi-Apps goldens; Thunderbird and Multi-Apps health passed. A bounded developer probe reached mail.query_messages successfully, while an over-specific AWS subject filter correctly returned zero because the real subject uses the full service name. No model or evaluator was run.
implementation_evidence.offline_mailbox_validation: The cached local mailbox was extracted to a temporary directory; unfiltered parameterized query returned one attachment-bearing message and attachments.save wrote 23369 bytes to the unrelated temporary basename unrelated-output-name.pdf with a 64-hex SHA-256. The temporary directory was destroyed and no expected evaluator artifact was consulted.

selection.method: targeted A/B for the preserved Order 122 v127 untouched baseline failure
